tagline: Highlight records in list and Kanban views with configurable color rules on any model
problem: Users spend hours scanning list and Kanban views. Status is buried in columns and easy to miss.
solution: Smart Color Tags is a generic color rule engine. Administrators define domain-based rules with priority, color, icon, and badge label. Matching records get visual tags in list and Kanban views without custom code.
benefits: Works on any Odoo model, including custom apps
Priority-based rules with domain builder, no coding
Colored badges, icons, and row accents in list and Kanban
Search filters by tag color on supported models
Cached rule evaluation for responsive pages

features.title: Generic rule engine
features.text: Create color rules for CRM, sales, invoices, stock, HR, projects, or any model.

features.title: Visual badges
features.text: Show OVERDUE, PAID, VIP, and custom labels beside record names.

features.title: Priority matching
features.text: Higher priority rules win when multiple conditions match.

features.title: List and Kanban accents
features.text: Row highlights and card accents make records understandable at a glance.
